name: Robert Biedroń, Nikolas Farantouris - § 23/3
title: REPORT on implementation and delivery of the Sustainable Development Goals in view of the 2025 High-Level Political Forum
part_context: Highlights that improvements in reducing adolescent birth rates and in access to modern contraceptive methods do not benefit all women and girls equally; points to the persisting social, economic and regional inequalities hindering the broadening of positive trends; calls for the EU to ensure, as a priority, access to safe and effective contraception methods and to legal abortion services across Member States and to contribute to the same through its external policies; reiterates its call for the right to safe and legal abortion to be included in the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights;
